title: Cohomological bound for closed projective subschemes
statement: For every closed immersion X into projective N-space over a Noetherian ring A, every quasi-coherent finitely presented F on X, every q>N and every natural twist t, H^q(X,F tensor i^*O(t)) is zero.

proof.text: Restrict the N+1 standard affine coordinate opens to X by inverse image under the closed immersion. They cover X and are affine. The composite X to projective space to Spec A is separated. The twist is invertible, so tensoring F with it is quasi-coherent. Apply the separated affine-base specialization of the affine Cech comparison to this cover and twisted module.

Construct chosen intersections as finite infima of the restricted opens; their universal properties follow from the poset of opens. Identify its signed site Cech differential with the explicit abelian presheaf Cech differential degreewise, and forget module scalars. Apply the alternating Cech comparison to this same cover.

For q>N, a strictly increasing map from Fin(q+1) into ULift(Fin(N+1)) would be injective, contradicting cardinalities. The degree-q alternating cochain group is therefore zero, so its homology is zero. Transport this along the alternating homology isomorphism, the explicit Cech encoding isomorphism, and the affine Cech linear equivalence to obtain subsingleton ordinary cohomology.
Transport subsingletonness from ordinary cohomology through the additive module-cohomology source comparison. ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton gives precisely the unchanged conclusion.

theorem isZero_closedImmersion_twist_above_dimension
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {X : Scheme.{u}} {N : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (N + 1)); Spec (.of A))) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (q t : ℕ) (hq : N < q) :
    IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj
      (tensorObj F (ProjectiveSpace.twistRestrict i t)))
